England Head Coach John Mitchell Rotates Red Roses Squad for USA Clash

Squad Changes Ahead of USA Fixture

England head coach John Mitchell has announced six changes to the starting XV for the upcoming Test match against the USA in New Jersey. Despite the team's recent back-to-back losses, Mitchell continues his focus on squad rotation and testing new personnel combinations.

Key changes include:

  • Backs: Tatyana Heard, Claudia Moloney-MacDonald, Flo Robinson, and Holly Aitchison will make their first starts of the tour.
  • Forwards: Mackenzie Carson and Maud Muir have been rotated into the pack, replacing Hannah Botterman and Sarah Bern.
  • Scrum-half: Flo Robinson earns her first Test start, with Mitchell citing a desire for a greater running threat from the nine position.

Kildunne Remains on Bench

Ellie Kildunne, the 2024 World Rugby player of the year, will remain on the bench for the second consecutive match. Mitchell previously noted that the full-back is required to demonstrate "greater consistency" following her omission from the starting lineup in last week's 31-22 loss to Canada.

Coaching Staff Developments

Mitchell confirmed that defensive consultant Shaun Edwards has departed the touring party. The head coach explained that Edwards' departure was pre-planned before the third match of the tour. Mitchell has assumed the responsibilities of the defensive coach for the current week. Regarding the team's transition, Mitchell acknowledged that the frequent changes in coaching perspectives may have been challenging for the players but emphasized that the current period is essential for building long-term depth.

Context and Verification

England enters the fixture following a dip in form that saw their 41-match unbeaten streak end. Mitchell remains focused on the broader development of the team, emphasizing that the current Test losses will not define the squad's long-term vision or philosophy.

  • Head-to-Head History: England has historically dominated the USA, securing 21 victories in their 22 encounters. The sole defeat occurred during the 1991 World Cup final.
  • Official Team Lists: Fans and analysts can verify the full squad lists and official player replacements via the official England Rugby website or their verified social media channels.
  • Upcoming Match: The fixture takes place in New Jersey, serving as the third and final match of the current tour.
